description: Java class AndroidLogcatReceiver for processing Android logcat output, parsing log lines, managing message headers, and expanding stack traces.

classes.name: AndroidLogcatReceiver
classes.description: Main class for receiving and processing Android logcat output, handling message parsing, stack trace expansion, and cancellation.

classes.name: LogMessageHeader
classes.description: Inner class representing the header information of a log message, including timestamp, log level, process ID, thread ID, app package, and tag.

methods.name: AndroidLogcatReceiver
methods.description: Constructor initializing the receiver with a device and writer.

methods.name: processNewLine
methods.description: Processes each new line of log output, parsing headers or expanding stack traces.

methods.name: getByLetterString
methods.description: Converts a single-character string to a LogLevel, with special handling for 'F'.

methods.name: isCancelled
methods.description: Checks if the receiver has been canceled.

methods.name: getFullMessage
methods.description: Formats a full log message using the header information.
